description: Propagation log of the carry service: table carry_propagations, one record per propagated carry of a task.

documentation.table: carry_propagations: one record per Propagate call of a task. The key {task_id, digits, position} is the natural key of a call: within one addition the successor asks for the carry of each number ending in 9 once, so a retried call finds its own record. Stored on disk only (dets, no copy in memory). Records are never updated; the retention job deletes those older than AAAS_RETENTION_HOURS.

attributes.key: {task_id, digits, position}: the natural key of the call.
attributes.task_id: Task the call was made for (lowercase UUIDv7, binary).
attributes.digits: Digits of the request, least significant first (list of 0..9).
attributes.result: Digits after the carry, least significant first.
attributes.event_id: eventId of the aaas.carry.propagated.v1 event of the call (UUIDv7).
attributes.event: That event exactly as published (JSON text); a retried call publishes it again.
attributes.propagated_at: Unix time in milliseconds when the call was recorded; read by the retention job.
attributes.trace_id: Trace identifier of the call (32 hexadecimal digits).
